name: Input Buffer
description: Practice training wheels: early clicks get delayed a few ticks so you survive tight timings.

rescue-window.name: Rescue window (ticks)
rescue-window.description: A death this many ticks or fewer after a click counts as 'caused by an early click' and gets rescued. 240 ticks = 1 second.

practice-only.name: Practice mode only
practice-only.description: Only buffer inputs while in practice mode, so normal-mode runs stay legit.

show-label.name: Show in-game label
show-label.description: Show the current stage and live tick counter in the top-left corner while playing.
